reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Service for Foreign Policy Instruments

title.narrative: Taking COBERM further: Joint EU-UNDP Initiative for Lasting and Inclusive Peace (FLIP)

description.narrative:
Due to a lack of interaction and direct dialogue across the dividing lines between Tbilisi, Sukhumi and Tskhinvali, a long range of security, humanitarian, human rights and development challenges remain unresolved.

The new COBERM / FLIP initiative aims to sustain and improve the enabling environment for lasting peace through inclusive and locally-led peacebuilding within and across divided communities in Georgia.

Specific objectives under this initiative are to

-        Improve the capacity of local civil society actors active in conflict prevention and peacebuilding

-        Increase the engagement of youth, women and marginalised groups in confidence-building processes

-        ensure inclusive processes for sustainable conflict prevention and peacebuilding
